patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.companion.pa: Hold your own contract in your main hand and use the call key, ] by default. Change it in Controls. Press again to recall her. A manually called companion stays when you switch items.$(br2)Actual enemy damage while holding the contract can call its stored maid to protect you. She rests after danger passes. Environmental damage does not trigger this.

To let her stay in your house, use Touhou Little Maid's home mode or ask her to sit and wait. She keeps your chosen work and will not leave just because you go away or get hurt.$(br2)Recall requires the same world and a distance of at most 32 blocks. Go back to her if she is far away or in another world. Visit your Contract Interior to see her there.

One maid cannot stay home and accompany you at the same time. To take her on an adventure, return to her, recall her and bring her contract weapon.$(br2)A tassel or knot lets your traveling companion select combat work for her contract weapon. Without either, you choose her work. At home she keeps her own equipment and work.

patchouli.maid_weapon.entry.projection_b: A small keepsake can accompany her a long way. Give a bauble to your maid and place it in her bauble slot.$(br2)The Resonance Sword Tassel lets her use the contract weapon when manifested and choose combat work to match. The Guardian Ribbon lets her wear armor like yours while you choose her work.$(br2)The Heartbound Knot does both with a single bauble. Choose one of these three to wear; removing it returns her original equipment.

Craft these at a Touhou Little Maid altar, with one item on each pedestal.$(br2)Resonance Sword Tassel: 3 string, 1 gold nugget, 1 amethyst shard and 1 red dye; costs 0.15 P.$(br2)Guardian Ribbon: 3 string, 2 leather and 1 amethyst shard; costs 0.15 P.

Heartbound Knot: one each of Resonance Sword Tassel, Guardian Ribbon, diamond, gold ingot, amethyst shard and ender pearl; costs 0.3 P.$(br2)Tie the tassel and ribbon together, so she can carry familiar arms and armor on your next adventure.$(br2)See Touhou Little Maid's guide for altar construction and use.
